definitions.visible_camera: GT target pixels >= 200 (480x640 GT render, T47 keep rule)
definitions.identity_fail: >=1 visible camera and in every visible camera the raw argmax patch is not on the target (map_scores peak_on_target: target coverage of argmax patch > 0.05)
definitions.seed_fail: seed precision < 0.5 (GT-target seeds / all seeds; no seeds -> fail)
definitions.region_fail: seed passed and (chosen-cluster purity < 0.8 or merged); merged = chosen cluster holds >=1 GT neighbour-fruit point and >=1 GT target point
definitions.no_cluster: seed passed and no target named (0 frames observed)
definitions.no_visible_camera: no camera with >= 200 target px: stage (1) undefined, reported separately
definitions.error_start_stage: first failing stage in the order identity -> seed -> region
definitions.coverage: target observed points (not support) inside chosen cluster / target observed points
definitions.min_neighbour_mesh_dist: min distance between visual-mesh vertices of the target and of each other fruit (GT pose); collision-geom mj_geomDistance also recorded (distmax 0.5 m)
definitions.bootstrap: moving block bootstrap within each record, block 5 frames, non-circular, B=10000, seed 5205; scene = sum over its records (independent draws); CI = 2.5/97.5 percentiles of the resampled frame count
definitions.operational_choices_by_verifier: visible threshold, argmax-on-target rule (0.05), merged rule (>=1 point), no_visible handling and bootstrap form were fixed before the stage counts were computed

A_conditional.definition: independent flags per frame (T52 fixed thresholds): identity_fail = >=1 visible cam and argmax off target in all visible cams; seed_fail = seed precision < 0.5; region = has_target and (purity < 0.8 or merged), not conditioned on seed; earliest = first flagged in order identity -> seed -> region/no_cluster, 'none' if no flag; no-visible-camera frames have identity undefined (flag false). CIs: moving-block bootstrap within record, block 5, B 10000, seed 5205, scene = sum of records; fraction CI = ratio of resampled counts.

B_merge_scene1800.definition: merged = chosen geometry (pipeline target, T52 membership rule) holds >= 1 GT neighbour-fruit point and >= 1 GT target point (per-body GT label, 3 mm); gt_ratio = mean attention of GT-target points / mean of the main merged neighbour's points inside the chosen geometry (normalised = cloud attention, raw = AttentionPointCloud.raw_attention); pipeline_* = this frame's split decision on the frame cluster holding most target points (split ratio = mean attention of the largest-mass 15 mm component / max of the others, normalised, attention_split_ratio_source=normalized); forced_15mm = production split_by_attention on the chosen geometry with the trigger forced (counterfactual); gt gap = visual-mesh vertex distance target-neighbour (GT pose)

C_l8h2_identity_fail_but_correct.definition: L8H2 frames with flag_identity_fail (>= 1 visible camera, raw 2D argmax off the target in every visible camera) and identity_correct true; all four held-out records. argmax_class = GT class of the argmax 16x16 patch per camera (T52 frames). peak_3d = body under the 3D attention peak point (grounding.attention_peak_index). top_score_cluster = rank-0 cluster by target_score. chosen membership 'kept_geometry' = TargetConfirm geometry from an earlier frame (indices do not index this cloud).

figures.kind: graph + table (a: failure/success stage flags, b: success-frame flag fractions with CI, c: per-frame split ratio headfix, d: mechanism table)
